image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of a pipe organ console. The foreground features a vertical row of cream-colored, mushroom-shaped stop knobs (drawknobs) mounted on a dark wooden jamb. In the background, blurred by bokeh, are multiple stacked keyboards (manuals) with black and white keys. The lighting is warm and artificial, highlighting the glossy finish of the stops.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The plastic/ivory texture of the stop knobs appears slightly too smooth and uniform, lacking the microscopic surface imperfections expected in macro photography, suggesting mild AI smoothing.

The black keys in the blurred background appear to merge into the white keys in a way that defies standard optical blur; the boundaries seem to 'melt' rather than just defocus, particularly in the middle manual.
The perspective lines of the keyboards shift slightly inconsistently between the upper and lower visible manuals, though this could be attributed to lens distortion.
